nuextract3_why: NuExtract3 is a 4B vision-language model (Qwen3.5-4B base): fp16 weights alone are ~8 GB, far above the 3.5 GiB available RAM
Official quantizations are W8A8 / W4A16 in compressed-tensors format, targeted at vLLM/GPU serving; compressed-tensors has no supported CPU inference path in this environment
No GGUF conversion of NuExtract3 exists on the Hub (searched 2026-09-17), so llama.cpp CPU quantized inference is not available
The model also carries a vision tower and MTP head with no CPU benefit
nuextract.fallback_used: numind/NuExtract-1.5-tiny (official NuMind, same NuExtract model family)
nuextract.status: RUNNING LOCALLY (CPU, smallest technically sound NuExtract variant; not an unrelated substitute)

langextract.constraint: local backend requires a local Gemma (MediaPipe) model too large for 3.5 GiB RAM; remote Gemini backend is forbidden by experiment policy (only Mistral allowed remote)

ram_policy: models are loaded per-stage in separate process invocations and released between stages to stay under the 3.9 GiB RAM ceiling; no two large models are resident at once
